data.long_meaning: The name Ejajul is derived from the Sanskrit language and means 'God's Grace'. This name is often given to babies as a sign of blessings from the divine. It is believed that the child named Ejajul will be protected and guided by the gods throughout their life. The name Ejajul carries the meaning “God's Grace” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ejajul usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
